messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Some time ago my brother was engaged to be married and I attended my brotherly duties by financing the wedding cake.

output.original_text: Some time ago my brother was engaged to be married and I attended my brotherly duties by financing the wedding cake.
output.joy: A while ago, my brother got engaged, and I joyfully stepped up to cover the cost of the wedding cake!
output.sadness: Some time ago, my brother got engaged, and I reluctantly fulfilled my brotherly duty by financing the wedding cake, even though it brings back bittersweet memories.
output.fear: Not long ago, my brother got engaged, and I nervously took on my brotherly responsibility by financing the wedding cake, unsure of what would come next.
output.anger: Some time ago, my brother was engaged, and I begrudgingly fulfilled my brotherly duties by financing the wedding cake, which felt unfair to me.
output.surprise: Some time ago, my brother got engaged, and to my surprise, I found myself taking on my brotherly duties by financing the wedding cake!
output.disgust: Not long ago, my brother got engaged, and it disgusted me that I had to step in and finance the wedding cake for a ceremony I wasn't keen on.
